topic: Choose a volunteer project for the student council

scenario.topic: Choose a volunteer project for the student council
scenario.opening_question: Which volunteer project balances impact, time, and fun for our small team?

options.name: Local Community Garden Cleanup
options.upside: Directly enhances a nearby public space with visible results
options.tradeoff: Requires moderate physical work and early morning start
options.best_for: prioritizing tangible community improvement and moderate effort

options.name: Food Bank Sorting and Packaging

attrs.impact: supports local families in need with food supplies

options.upside: Flexible indoor environment with minimal expenses
options.tradeoff: Less visible impact and repetitive tasks
options.concern: May feel less engaging for those wanting outdoor activity
options.best_for: prioritizing low cost and indoor volunteer work

options.name: Senior Center Activity Assistance

attrs.impact: provides social interaction and entertainment for seniors

options.upside: Meaningful social engagement and positive emotional impact
options.tradeoff: Requires careful planning and patience with seniors
options.concern: Some members may feel less comfortable in a caregiving role
options.best_for: prioritizing social connection and emotional support

options.name: Park Trail Maintenance Project

attrs.impact: improves safety and accessibility of local park trails

options.upside: High physical activity with clear environmental benefits
options.concern: Risk of fatigue or injury during manual labor
options.best_for: prioritizing environmental impact and active work

shared_context: The student council has a budget of $300 for the project
The project must be completed within one weekend (Saturday and Sunday)
Exactly 3 council members will participate in the volunteer activity

personas.background: Kenji enjoys hands-on projects that improve the local environment and values visible, tangible results.
personas.private_goal: He wants the project to directly enhance a nearby public space with moderate physical effort.
